# GNK ASG — Content Quality Gate

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

Every prepared article, visual, video brief or public text must pass this gate before it becomes visible.

## Required checks for each article

- Clear title.
- Clear category.
- Minimum useful length.
- English language for international content.
- Croatian language only where the page is Croatian.
- Main story remains GNK ASG and GNK DINAMO Ltd.
- Personal layer is accurate and discreet.
- No forced repetition.
- No unfinished placeholder text.
- No private data.
- No unclear claims.
- No public commitment unless approved.
- Canonical URL prepared.
- Description prepared.
- Preview image prepared.
- Internal links prepared.
- Mobile readability checked.

## Required checks for each visual

- Correct format.
- Branded design.
- Clear topic.
- No misleading scene.
- No fake person image.
- Descriptive file name.
- Alt text prepared.
- Works on mobile preview.

## Required checks for each video brief

- Based on prepared or public portal material.
- Clear title.
- Clear script.
- Thumbnail concept.
- Description draft.
- Topic remains safe and informational.
- No public release before channel setup.

## Required checks for each short public text

- Links back to the portal.
- Does not replace the portal as the source.
- Does not overstate the message.
- Does not sound like a legal or formal commitment.
- Uses a professional corporate tone.

## Fail rule

If one required element is missing, the item remains in preparation.
